**Important: YOU MUST USE subagents when available for the task.**

**Stack:** Laravel 12.0/PHP 8.2+, React 19/TypeScript, Mantine 7.17/Tailwind CSS 4.0, Inertia.js 2.0 with SSR, Filament 3.3, SQLite (default; multiple databases configured), Vite 6.0/Laravel Vite Plugin, PHPUnit 11.5, Pint, ESLint, Prettier, Tabler Icons React, Ziggy, Carbon. Full-stack SPA with SSR, TypeScript, Mantine/Tailwind UI, Filament admin, Breeze/Inertia auth, and Vite HMR/concurrent dev server.

Delegate by expertise: Laravel backend, React components, UI/UX styling, API/architecture, code review, performance, full-stack integration, Filament admin, authentication, database, state management, and testing. Use the designated `<REDACTED_USER>` agent(s) for these roles.

<!-- BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES START -->
Markdown tasks: `backlog/tasks/`; drafts: `backlog/drafts/`; docs: `backlog/docs/`; decisions: `backlog/decisions/`.
Every implementation decision starts with reading the corresponding Markdown task file.
All task operations should be done via Backlog.md CLI tool, this will correctly update the metadata in the task files and keep the project in sync. NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES.
**Always use `--plain` flag** when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md
When users mention one or multiple tasks, they are probably suggesting to use Backlog.md CLI tool
Ask questions to the user if something is not clear or ambiguous.
Break down the task into smaller, manageable parts if it is too large or complex.
Use a clear brief title that summarizes the task. Give a concise purpose/goal summary without implementation details or code snippets. List specific, measurable outcomes as checkboxes. Acceptance Criteria define testable outcomes, behaviors, and verifiable requirements—not implementation steps; keep them clear, concise, complete, and user-focused where applicable.

Tasks are stored as `task-<id> - <title>.md`. When breaking down features, put foundations first, use dependency order, make each task independently valuable, and avoid blocking dependencies. Tasks must be **atomic** and **testable**. If a task is too large, break it down into smaller subtasks. Each task should represent a single unit of work that can be completed in a single PR.
**Never** reference tasks that are to be done in the future or that are not yet created. You can only reference tasks (id < current task id).
When creating multiple tasks, ensure they are **independent** and they do not depend on future tasks.

Mandatory sections for every task:
**Implementation Plan**: (The **"how"**)
Outline the steps to achieve the task. Because the implementation details may change after the task is created, **the implementation plan must be added only after putting the task in progress** and before starting working on the task.
**Implementation Notes**: (Imagine this is a PR note)
Start with a brief summary of what has been implemented. Document your approach, decisions, challenges, and any deviations from the plan. This section is added after you are done working on the task. Keep it concise but informative; explain ONLY the core changes and assume that others will read the code to understand the details.
**IMPORTANT**: Do not implement anything else that deviates from the **Acceptance Criteria**. If you need to implement something that is not in the AC, update the AC first and then implement it or create a new task for it.

Examples of outcomes: `[ ] Resolver returns correct data for happy path`; `[ ] Error response matches REST`; `[ ] P95 latency ≤ 50 ms under 100 RPS`. Plans may list research, implementation, tests, monitoring, or benchmarking. Notes cover features, decisions/trade-offs, and modified files.

Always ensure you have:
1. ✅ Marked all acceptance criteria as completed (change `- [ ]` to `- [x]`)
2. ✅ Added an `## Implementation Notes` section documenting your approach
3. ✅ Run all tests and linting checks
4. ✅ Updated relevant documentation

A task is **Done** only when **ALL** of the following are complete:
1. **Acceptance criteria** checklist in the task file is fully checked (all `- [ ]` changed to `- [x]`).
2. **Implementation plan** was followed or deviations were documented in Implementation Notes.
3. **Automated tests** (unit + integration) cover new logic.
4. **Static analysis**: linter & formatter succeed.
All relevant docs updated (any relevant README file, backlog/docs, backlog/decisions, etc.).
Task file **MUST** have an `## Implementation Notes` section added summarising:
Features implemented or modified
Technical decisions and trade-offs
Modified or added files
6. **Review**: self review code.
7. **Task hygiene**: status set to **Done** via CLI (`backlog task edit <id> -s Done`).
8. **No regressions**: performance, security and licence checks green.
⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Never mark a task as Done without completing ALL items above.

Use these exact CLI commands as applicable:
```text
backlog task list -s "To Do" --plain
backlog task 42 --plain
backlog task edit 42 -a @{yourself} -s "In Progress"
backlog task edit 42 --plan "1. Analyze current implementation\n2. Identify bottlenecks\n3. Refactor in phases"
backlog task create "Refactor DB layer" -p 42 -a @{yourself} -d "Description" --ac "Tests pass,Performance improved"
backlog task edit 42 -s Done --notes "Implemented GraphQL resolver with error handling and performance monitoring"
backlog task create "Add OAuth System"
backlog task create "Feature" -d "Add authentication system"
backlog task create "Feature" -a <REDACTED_USER>
backlog task create "Feature" -s "In Progress"
backlog task create "Feature" -l auth,backend
backlog task create "Feature" --priority high
backlog task create "Feature" --plan "1. Research\n2. Implement"
backlog task create "Feature" --ac "Must work,Must be tested"
backlog task create "Feature" --notes "Started initial research"
backlog task create "Feature" --dep task-1,task-2
backlog task create -p 14 "Add Login with Google"
backlog task create "Feature" -d "Description" -a <REDACTED_USER> -s "To Do" -l auth --priority high --ac "Must work" --notes "Initial setup done" --dep task-1 -p 14
backlog task list [-s <status>] [-a <assignee>] [-p <parent>]
backlog task list --parent 42
backlog task list -p task-42
backlog task 7
backlog task 7 --plain
backlog task edit 7 -a <REDACTED_USER> -l auth,backend
backlog task edit 7 --plan "Implementation approach"
backlog task edit 7 --ac "New criterion,Another one"
backlog task edit 7 --notes "Completed X, working on Y"
backlog task edit 7 --
